timings.metric: p50 microseconds; nested scopes and separate medians must not be added
timings.source_snapshot_scope: Device/vCPU/VM state collection, GET ioctls, inter-thread exchange, bitcode encode, tmpfs write and API handling; pure codec time not isolated.

ept_scope: EPT/nested fault service is a major contributor to post-resume ACK wait, not a synonym for whole-transition overhead. Reduced L1 traces observed 23 faults before ACK; excluding faults after ACK does not make the transition fault-free.
